guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table on mobile without horizontal page overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep semantic table/thead/th markup and let the table scroll in a wrapper on small screens instead of crushing columns below legibility.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: compat table uses thead/th inside .table-wrap; name/version columns do not break mid-token and the notes column has a min-width so narrow screens scroll. Exception: no sticky/stacked layout, to match the shared v148 table pattern.

guidanceConsulted.query: lazy loading cross-origin iframe embed sandbox
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native loading="lazy" for below-the-fold iframes with explicit dimensions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: showcase iframe is loading="lazy" with width/height, below the fold.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic HTML, name note regions, and do not rely on colour alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: role=note + aria-label on the banner; unsupported browsers say 'not supported' in text as well as using a dashed border.
